acceptance_criteria.source: "Pin state moves into the session store. idea-board.tsx currently holds pinnedIds in local useState — lift it to `pinned: PinnedRef[]` with togglePin/clearPins."
acceptance_criteria.text: Pin state lives in the session store (stores/session.ts) as `pinned: PinnedRef[]` with togglePin and clearPins actions, and idea-board.tsx no longer holds pinnedIds in local useState.

acceptance_criteria.source: "PinnedRef { id, title, lane, imageUrl: string | null, sourceUrl: string | null } ... The board passes imageUrl: null for stickers. Lane B's tiles will pass a real URL into the identical shape — do not build a second pin path for them."
acceptance_criteria.text: PinnedRef has the shape { id, title, lane, imageUrl: string | null, sourceUrl: string | null }, the board pins stickers with imageUrl: null, and there is a single pin path that Lane B tiles can reuse with a real URL.

acceptance_criteria.source: "full width, borderless, same neutral palette. Left: pinned thumbnails ~48px ... Label the group `N pins · conditioning input`, not \"Pinned\""
acceptance_criteria.text: The pin rail is full width, borderless, in the same neutral palette, shows the pinned thumbnails (~48px) on the left, and labels the group `N pins · conditioning input` (not "Pinned").

acceptance_criteria.source: "Right: a single `Generate` button."
acceptance_criteria.text: The rail carries a single `Generate` button on its right.

acceptance_criteria.source: "The rail is absent at zero pins" / "Zero pins hides the rail."
acceptance_criteria.text: The rail is absent when there are zero pins.

acceptance_criteria.source: "animates in with the existing CSS conventions in index.css (`workspace-enter`/`sticker-enter`); main dropped the motion dependency, do not resurrect it."
acceptance_criteria.text: The rail animates in using the existing CSS conventions in index.css (`workspace-enter`/`sticker-enter`) and no motion dependency is added.

acceptance_criteria.source: "`POST /v1/generate`, body { session_id, transcript, pins: PinnedRef[] } ... Response carries { image_url, prompt, model, reference_count }" and "Pydantic v2 at every boundary"
acceptance_criteria.text: The backend exposes POST /v1/generate accepting { session_id, transcript, pins: PinnedRef[] } and responding with image_url, prompt, model and reference_count, with Pydantic v2 models at the boundary.

acceptance_criteria.source: "One OpenAI call using the existing OPENAI_SYNTHESIS_MODEL setting. Input: the transcript, the current VisualIntent from the distiller, and the pin titles. Output: ONE concise image prompt, under 80 words ... Constrain it with a Pydantic schema so a malformed prompt is a validation error"
acceptance_criteria.text: The synthesis step makes one OpenAI call using the existing OPENAI_SYNTHESIS_MODEL setting, with the transcript, the current VisualIntent and the pin titles as input, and validates the output with a Pydantic schema enforcing one concise prompt under 80 words so a malformed prompt is a validation error.

acceptance_criteria.source: "Never send the raw transcript to fal — the summary is the point."
acceptance_criteria.text: The raw transcript is never sent to fal; only the synthesised prompt is.

acceptance_criteria.source: "Submit to fal with X-Fal-Store-IO: 0. ... Use fal's queue endpoint and POLL it. Do NOT build a webhook"
acceptance_criteria.text: Generation submits to fal's queue REST endpoint with the X-Fal-Store-IO: 0 header and polls for the result; no webhook is built.

acceptance_criteria.source: "Cap the poll at ~45s, then return a typed timeout."
acceptance_criteria.text: The poll is capped at ~45s and on expiry the route returns a typed timeout response.

acceptance_criteria.source: "do not retry a fal submit (it costs a generation)"
acceptance_criteria.text: A fal submit is never retried.

acceptance_criteria.source: "Explicit timeouts on every outbound call"
acceptance_criteria.text: Every outbound call (OpenAI, fal submit, fal poll) has an explicit timeout.

acceptance_criteria.source: "uv.lock committed. ... Do not add a dependency beyond what fal needs — plain httpx against the REST queue is enough, no SDK."
acceptance_criteria.text: The fal client uses plain httpx against the REST queue with no SDK and no new dependency, and uv.lock is committed/consistent.

acceptance_criteria.source: "Pins carrying a public https imageUrl → FAL_REFERENCE_MODEL (flux-pro/kontext/max/multi) with image_urls, capped at FAL_MAX_REFERENCE_IMAGES. No public URLs → FAL_FALLBACK_MODEL (flux/schnell), text only."
acceptance_criteria.text: When pins carry a public https imageUrl, generation uses FAL_REFERENCE_MODEL with those URLs as image_urls, capped at FAL_MAX_REFERENCE_IMAGES; when none do, generation uses FAL_FALLBACK_MODEL text-only.

acceptance_criteria.source: "When no pin has a public imageUrl, the pins still steer: their titles go into the synthesis as visual steering terms, and the response reports reference_count: 0. Do not silently drop them, do not fabricate a URL, and do not tell the user the image was conditioned on references when it was not."
acceptance_criteria.text: When no pin has a public imageUrl, the pin titles still reach the synthesis as steering terms, the response reports reference_count: 0, no URL is fabricated, and the user is not told the image was conditioned on references.

acceptance_criteria.source: "allow exactly ONE generation in flight per session, and reject a second with a typed \"already generating\"" / "A second click while one is running is refused, not queued."
acceptance_criteria.text: Exactly one generation is allowed in flight per session; a second concurrent request is refused with a typed 'already generating' response rather than queued.

acceptance_criteria.source: "Add FAL_KEY, FAL_REFERENCE_MODEL, FAL_FALLBACK_MODEL, FAL_MAX_REFERENCE_IMAGES to config.py — they are already in the local .env, so read them, do not redefine defaults that contradict it."
acceptance_criteria.text: config.py gains FAL_KEY, FAL_REFERENCE_MODEL, FAL_FALLBACK_MODEL and FAL_MAX_REFERENCE_IMAGES settings read from the environment, with no defaults that contradict the local .env/.env.example.

acceptance_criteria.source: "Honour demo_mode=\"fixture\" with a canned result and no network" / "Fixture mode returns a canned result with the network unplugged."
acceptance_criteria.text: With demo_mode="fixture", POST /v1/generate returns a canned result without opening any network connection.

acceptance_criteria.source: "The generated image takes the workpane, and the synthesised prompt renders verbatim beneath it in small muted type, alongside the model id and the reference count."
acceptance_criteria.text: After a successful generation the image takes the workpane and the synthesised prompt is rendered verbatim beneath it in small muted type alongside the model id and the reference count.

acceptance_criteria.source: "The pin rail stays visible so a second Generate is one click away."
acceptance_criteria.text: The pin rail stays visible on the result view so a second Generate is one click away.

acceptance_criteria.source: "Button states: idle, generating (disabled, quiet pulse — no spinner), error (one line plus a correlation id, still re-clickable)."
acceptance_criteria.text: The Generate button has three states: idle; generating (disabled, quiet pulse, no spinner); error (one line plus a correlation id, still clickable).

acceptance_criteria.source: "No fal or OpenAI key anywhere near apps/web — both calls are server-side." / "Nothing in dist/ contains FAL_KEY or the OpenAI key — grep and prove it."
acceptance_criteria.text: No fal or OpenAI key material appears in apps/web source or the built dist/ (shown by grep), and both the OpenAI and fal calls are made server-side only.

acceptance_criteria.source: "pnpm lint/typecheck/build and uv run mypy . / ruff check . all pass."
acceptance_criteria.text: The repository's checks pass: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, uv run mypy . (strict), uv run ruff check .

acceptance_criteria.text: New TypeScript is strict with no `any` and no non-null assertion `!`.

acceptance_criteria.text: New Python contains no bare except.

acceptance_criteria.text: README.md and docs/ are not modified.
